single_item.Facts SERP: one results page per run (the facts check's keyword)
single_item.Facts SERP (Retry): the second attempt of that one request, one request
single_item.Get Crawl Summary: one poll of the one crawl task (read with .first())
single_item.Get Crawled Pages: one pages request for the one crawl task (read with .first())
single_item.Get Crawled Pages (Retry): the second attempt of that one pages request
single_item.Keyword Data: one keyword-overview task per run (all keywords in one request body)
single_item.Keyword Data (Retry): the second attempt of that one task, one request
single_item.SERP Top 10: one results page per run (the head keyword); F-SERP sends it up to three times, one request each
single_item.SERP Top 10 (Light Retry): the head keyword's lighter third attempt, one request
single_item.SERP Top 10 (Retry): the head keyword's second attempt, one request
single_item.Start Crawl: one on_page/task_post per audit (it creates the paid crawl task)
single_item.Start Crawl (Retry): the second attempt of that one task_post, one request
